newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso still strong, market awaits U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso still strong, market awaits U.S. data.

text.p: The Mexican peso retained its initial firmness in mid-morning trade on Monday amid a calm market awaiting reaction in the U.S. bond market to economic data, dealers said.
"We need to see how the long bond reacts to (U.S. second quarter) employment costs tomorrow," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart stood 0.6 and 0.7 of a centavo firmer, respectively, at 7.7800/7.7830 and 7.7770/7.7810 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed trade for the day 1.1 centavos weaker at 7.7730/7.7760 per dollar.
The U.S. 30-year Treasury bond was up 10/32 to 6.43 percent.
